 Panthers at Blackhawks projected lineups
 By 
 NHL.com 
 @NHLMedia 
 October 24, 2026 
 Link copied 
 PANTHERS (5-4-2) at BLACKHAWKS (3-7-0) 
 3 p.m. ET; CHSN, SCRIPPS, SN, TVAS 
 Panthers projected lineup 
 Brady Tkachuk -- Sam Bennett -- Matthew Tkachuk
 Sandis Vilmanis -- Carter Verhaeghe -- Sam Reinhart
 Lars Eller -- Eetu Luostarinen -- Anton Lundell
 Bokondji Imama -- Cole Schwindt -- Garnet Hathaway
 Gustav Forsling -- Aaron Ekblad
 Niko Mikkola -- Seth Jones
 Dmitry Kulikov -- Radko Gudas
 Akira Schmid
 Cooper Black
 Scratched: Uvis Balinskis, Cole Reinhardt 
 Injured: Jacob Markstrom (upper body), Aleksander Barkov (knee), Brad Marchand (knee), Jonah Gadjovich (neck) 
 Blackhawks projected lineup 
 Roman Kantserov -- Connor Bedard -- Patrick Kane
 Tyler Bertuzzi -- Anton Frondell -- Jordan Greenway
 Teuvo Teravainen -- Frank Nazar -- Ryan Donato
 Cole Smith -- Ryan Greene -- Andrew Mangiapane
 Alex Vlasic -- Ian Cole
 Wyatt Kaiser -- Artyom Levshunov
 Kevin Korchinski -- Sam Rinzel
 Arvid Soderblom
 Spencer Knight
 Scratched: Ethan Del Mastro, Oliver Moore 
 Injured: Bowen Byram (upper body) 
 Status report 
 Each team practiced in Chicago on Saturday … Vilmanis and Gudas each are likely to return after being scratched for a 4-0 loss at Pittsburgh on Thursday … Schmid will start after Black made 18 saves against the Penguins in his NHL debut … Mangiapane may play in his first game since the Blackhawks’ season opener; he was activated off injured reserve on Friday and was scratched for a 4-1 loss to the Montreal Canadiens … Soderblom could play after Knight started the past five games. … Byram skated in a non-contact jersey on Saturday; the defenseman has missed three consecutive games.
